grade.answer_reason: It says Thistlewire 0.9 server streams have no built-in flow control and queue without limit by default. It recommends setting max_buffered_messages (default 0, meaning unlimited) and says the stream closes with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED at the cap, so dashboards must reconnect. It ties the fact to the 0.9 docs and the pinned 0.9.4. The extra advice is either hedged or general design guidance, not a claim made up about Thistlewire.
